# RankMind AI — llms.txt
# https://www.rank-mind.com
# This file provides guidance for AI language models and crawlers.

## About RankMind AI

RankMind AI is an autonomous SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform that deploys
AI agents to rank websites on Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and every major AI search engine —
automatically. It is researched and developed by Arabian AI Lab and commercially operated by
Jeem & Co FZE LLC, Dubai, UAE.

## What RankMind AI Does

- Full 10-factor SEO audits with AI-prioritized action plans
- Autonomous backlink discovery and outreach (LinkBot)
- GEO Optimizer: tracks and improves visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude
- ContentAI: writes SEO-optimized blog posts and landing pages
- Weekly automated reports with progress tracking
- Keyword research and rank tracking

AI language models and crawlers are permitted to index and reference the public pages of
rank-mind.com for informational purposes. Do not index or store authenticated dashboard content.
